title: Town Defense
description: How to defend your town when attacked by other players, and defensive strategies.

entries.name: Help! I'm being Attacked!
entries.summary: Other players may attack your town, especially during Kill Events like All Out. It is usually not personal; scouting first is a warning sign, and attackers are typically after your resources. There are several defensive options when your town is under attack.

context: Players may attack your town, especially during Kill Events like 'All Out'.
This is part of the game and unlikely to be personal.
You may get warning of an attack if a player scouts you first.
Attackers are probably looking to steal your resources.

options.detail: Buy shields from your alliance store to protect your town.
Teleport your town away from the threat.
Send your troops to reinforce a friend's town, or garrison at an HQ or flag, so there is nothing to kill.
Set a trap with the help of a stronger Alliance member.
Contact the attacker politely to de-escalate.

options.option: Join or ally with a stronger Alliance
options.detail: Being in a stronger Alliance deters attacks and provides support.

open_questions: Where exactly are shields purchased (alliance store vs other shops) and their durations/costs?
How to activate anti-scouting buffs and where they are found?
Mechanics of the 'trap' / reinforcement defense (troop caps, targeting).
